rows.name: USAspending.gov federal award transactions
rows.whatItProves: Literal purchase records: a buyer paid a named vendor a specific dollar amount to solve a named problem. Not a proxy for demand — it IS demand, settled.
rows.termsNote: Public open-government API, explicitly published for programmatic use.

rows.name: Open Collective — money actually raised by projects
rows.whatItProves: Real money moved to solve a problem, with public ledgers. Shows what people and companies voluntarily fund.
rows.termsNote: Public GraphQL API, no key for public data.

rows.name: Steam store — paid products with prices
rows.whatItProves: Paid catalogue with real prices; reviews act as a purchase proxy.
rows.termsNote: Public storefront search endpoint used by the store itself.

rows.name: itch.io — indie paid digital goods
rows.whatItProves: Instant listing, paid digital products, no gatekeeper review.
rows.termsNote: Public search page; JSON availability unverified — measured here.

rows.name: Envato / CodeCanyon — per-item SALES COUNTS and prices
rows.whatItProves: The highest-value missing measurement: actual units sold x actual price, per niche product. Direct willingness-to-pay at item level.
rows.credentialNote: Envato API personal token — free account, entered as a GitHub secret.
rows.termsNote: Official API with documented endpoints; token is free.
